message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on the fact: In May-June 2016, at Liu's home, defendant Chen repeatedly touched or used genitalia to touch the victim Liu (female, born 2009-07-26) on the vulva. This is sexual assault on a minor. Under Chinese criminal law, the relevant offense is "强奸罪" (rape) if sexual intercourse, but here it's touching genitalia, which is "猥亵儿童罪" (indecent assault on a minor) or "强制猥亵罪"? Actually Chinese law: Article 236 of Criminal Law: "猥亵儿童罪" for sexual assault on minors under 14. Also "强制猥亵罪" for non-consensual sexual acts with adults. Since victim is 7 years old, it's child. So the crime is "猥亵儿童罪". Also possibly "强奸罪" not applicable because no intercourse. So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]猥亵儿童罪<eoa>
